source_name: NBS – Registre (hub of all NBS supervisory registers)
why_relevant: Top-level index of every register NBS maintains; the cheapest way to snowball into new register endpoints (PSD2, RBUZ, register informácií/DORA, financial intermediaries) rather than guessing URLs.

source_name: NBS – Archív rozhodnutí (decision archive)
why_relevant: Historical backfill for the decision register — needed to build a multi-year time series of who was approved into which seat and when, and to establish tenure baselines.

source_name: NBS Fintech / Innovation Hub & FinTech Hub Slovakia section
why_relevant: The regulator's fintech-facing channel; the associated FinTech Hub Slovakia programme publishes cohorts of participating start-ups/scale-ups. Cohort lists are an actor-discovery pointer for exactly the small end this cell covers, and hub participation frequently precedes licence applications and senior hires.

source_name: IS EVO / elektronická platforma (Úrad vlády SR)
why_relevant: EVO is the state e-procurement platform (administration moved to Úrad vlády SR on 31.3.2022). It routes ~45% of in-scope contracts and points to where tender documentation, Q&A and bidder identities live; the documentation (súťažné podklady) often contains the buyer's internal org chart and role names for payment operations.

source_name: Index SME – rebríčky executive search firiem
why_relevant: Business magazine Index (SME) ranks Slovak executive search firms by revenue, partners and filled senior positions — the authoritative actor map for this cell and a source of aggregate placement volumes.

source_name: AmCham Slovakia — Our members (300+ companies)
why_relevant: 300+ member companies across sectors; the searchable directory identifies banks, payment providers and BSC/shared-service employers operating in SK — a high-yield seed list for hiring-signal scouting.

source_name: AmCham Slovakia – Business Service Center Forum (BSCF)
why_relevant: Industry association of ~39 member business-service centres (~40,000 experts) incl. banking/financial captives. Member list is a ready-made actor map; annual BSCF conference agendas and speaker lists reveal leadership moves and expansion plans.

source_name: Slovenská banková asociácia (SBA) — Členovia (member banks directory)
why_relevant: Enumerates the ~23-24 member banks covering ~99% of the Slovak banking sector — the canonical actor population for all follow-on A5 scouting (career pages, press rooms, management pages). Membership joins/exits are themselves organizational signals.

source_name: Asseco CE 'Napisali o nas' press clipping page
why_relevant: Vendor-curated clipping archive of Slovak media coverage of bank IT supply; one clipping explicitly discusses that Slovak banks do not name their IT suppliers, making this clipping trail the practical route into SK IT-trade press articles on bank programmes.

source_name: IT Asociácia Slovenska (ITAS) – member directory and cluster listings
why_relevant: National IT association whose member list includes regional clusters (Košice IT Valley) and delivery-centre operators serving banks; a compact actor map for the IT-services side of financial nearshoring.

source_name: IT Asociácia Slovenska (ITAS) — Členovia
why_relevant: 100+ ICT member companies with ~30k employees, incl. the systems integrators and vendors that staff bank IT/payments projects (Asseco CE, Posam, InterWay, Anasoft, Slovak Telekom, Microsoft, Cisco). A key employer population for A5 hiring signals on the supply side of banking technology.

source_name: Slovenská FinTech asociácia — Členovia
why_relevant: Member directory of Slovak fintech/payment-adjacent firms — the actor population for the non-bank payments segment that regulator registers only partly cover.

source_name: GreenPages.sk – executive search / personálne agentúry directory (Kariéra Guide)
why_relevant: Directory tied to the Kariéra Guide publication; enumerates SK executive search and staffing firms (incl. smaller local players such as TARGET Executive Search, Personality Group, Perfect Personal) that generic searches miss.

source_name: Greenpages.sk – directory of shared service centres (SSC) in Slovakia
why_relevant: Commercial directory listing business service centres operating in Slovakia; useful as a cross-check list of captive operators and their locations, including finance/banking back-office units.

source_name: Profesia Days (career festival) – exhibitor lists
why_relevant: Largest SK career fair (Bratislava 22–23 Apr 2026, Stará tržnica; also Košice). The exhibitor roster and programme reveal which banks/fintechs are in active mass-hiring mode and which functions they showcase (trainee, IT, shared services).

source_name: SARIO – Shared Service & Business Process Outsourcing Centres sector page
why_relevant: State investment agency's sector overview of the SSC/BPO industry (60+ centres, 40k+ employees), including regional distribution and named investors. Pointer to individual captive/GBS operators including banking back-office and finance shared services outside Bratislava.

source_name: Aeroleads — Top payments companies in Slovakia (actor-map pointer)
why_relevant: Enumerates ~22 SK payments companies, giving a ready candidate list of LinkedIn company pages to add to the monitoring set for the payments half of the cell.

source_name: AFISP — Asociácia finančných sprostredkovateľov a finančných poradcov
why_relevant: Since 2007 unites the major financial-intermediation and advisory firms; in 2025 it created expert committees (odborné komisie) that name sector professionals. Financial-advisory networks are large employers and their leadership churn is an A5 signal.

source_name: AHK Slowakei — Deutsch-Slowakische Industrie- und Handelskammer
why_relevant: German-Slovak bilateral chamber (founded 2005); German-owned banks/insurers and shared-service centres are members. Its member directory and board are a further actor/officeholder source; language dimension adds a third (de) beyond sk/en.

source_name: AppsRunTheWorld — Temenos T24 customer database
why_relevant: Third-party aggregator listing named institutions running a given core-banking product by country; a shortcut to hypotheses about which SK banks run which core, to be corroborated on vendor or bank sources.

source_name: Asociácia leasingových spoločností SR (ALS) — Riadni členovia
why_relevant: Explicit 'riadni členovia' page listing leasing/consumer-finance companies, many of them bank subsidiaries (a non-bank credit actor population that regulator lists fragment).

source_name: Asociácia obchodníkov s cennými papiermi (AOCP) — Zoznam členov
why_relevant: Directory of licensed Slovak investment firms/securities dealers — the capital-markets actor population adjacent to banking. AOCP's elected výbor historically names individuals with employer (e.g. Salve Investments, Fio, UniCredit, Privatbanka, RM-S Market), giving a senior-management sample for the sector.

source_name: AZZZ SR — Členovia (Asociácia zamestnávateľských zväzov a združení SR)
why_relevant: The other tripartite employer confederation; its member-union list is a directory-of-directories (each zväz has its own member companies), useful for mapping employer-side actors and labour-relations signals affecting finance-sector staffing.

source_name: Britcham — British Chamber of Commerce in the Slovak Republic, Our Members
why_relevant: ~120 member organisations incl. UK-linked financial and professional-services firms; smaller but higher-signal-per-entry directory, and Britcham event pages name speakers with titles.

source_name: CEE Chamber — top recruitment companies in Slovakia (pointer list)
why_relevant: Aggregated list naming SK recruiters (Pro HR, PERSONALITY and others) — a cheap way to snowball the recruiter watchlist beyond the internationally visible brands, which matters because local boutiques handle much of the mid-level banking movement.

source_name: eKariera.sk — employer career/company pages
why_relevant: Company-directory-style career site; its firm index is a pointer to SK financial employers and their recruiting brands.

source_name: FinReg.sk – SK financial-entity register aggregator
why_relevant: Aggregates regulatory and register data for SK financial-sector entities (e.g. Nexi Central Europe by DIČ), providing a convenient cross-index between NBS registrations, IČO/DIČ and corporate identity for the payments population.

source_name: ifirmy.sk / azet.sk firemné registre – SK business directories
why_relevant: Directory listings hold historical addresses and contact details for payments entities (e.g. Euronet Services Slovakia at Prievozská 4 vs Karadžičova 8), which helps detect office relocations and site changes that no press release announces.

source_name: INEKO – Hodnotenie formálnej nezávislosti inštitúcií (Finančné riaditeľstvo profile)
why_relevant: Think-tank database documenting appointment/dismissal mechanics, tenure and turnover of heads of SK state institutions. Gives the structural rules (who appoints whom, for how long) that let you anticipate leadership churn rather than only observe it.

source_name: Narodne dni kariery (AIESEC Slovakia job fair)
why_relevant: Long-running student/graduate job fair (18+ editions, Bratislava and Kosice) organised by AIESEC; participating-company lists and stand programmes reveal which banks target graduate pipelines and for which job families. Complements Profesia Days at the entry-level end.

source_name: Personálneagentúry.sk – SK staffing agency aggregator
why_relevant: Aggregator/lead portal listing Slovak staffing agencies by specialisation; useful for completing the actor map beyond the international brands.

source_name: Republiková únia zamestnávateľov (RÚZ) — Členovia
why_relevant: Employer confederation with mixed membership (sector unions plus individual corporates such as Slovnaft, Tesco, IBM, U.S. Steel). RÚZ is a tripartite social partner, so its positions and its member roster surface employment/labour-cost changes; financial-sector members appear via sector unions.

source_name: SAPIE — Slovak Alliance for Innovation Economy, general members directory
why_relevant: ~170-200 member companies spanning startups, fintechs, investors and corporates; the widest single directory of Slovak digital-economy actors, including payments/fintech players not captured by banking registers. SAPIE also produced a 'mapa slovenských inovátorov' (innovator map) — a pointer to yet more actor datasets.

source_name: SASP — Slovenská asociácia sprostredkovateľov v poisťovníctve
why_relevant: Insurance-brokerage association; member and board lists complete the distribution-side actor map alongside AFISP.

source_name: Slovenská asociácia poisťovní (SLASPO)
why_relevant: Member directory + governing bodies of Slovak insurers — the bancassurance-adjacent actor set; several members are bank-owned. Sector=both scope makes insurer leadership relevant.

source_name: Slovenská obchodná a priemyselná komora (SOPK)
why_relevant: Public-law chamber with regional offices; member database and event/committee activity give a broad company directory and named regional officeholders. Public-law status means its bodies are documented.

source_name: Tracxn – FinTech startups in Slovakia list
why_relevant: Reports a long tail (~222) of SK fintech startups — far more than any local list — making it the broadest actor-discovery pointer for the small end of this cell, with funding-round metadata attached.
